Comment: Runs the Snowflake randomization-check quality gate (via lambda/quality_gate.py), then notifies pass or fail via SNS.

Parameters.Message: Quality gate PASSED -- randomization check OK, safe to proceed.
Parameters.Subject: retail-media-uplift: quality gate passed
